lines.speaker: THE HOUSE
lines.text: Every house keeps a thread that should never be pulled.

lines.speaker: THE HOUSE
lines.text: But Wren heard her brother crying beneath the floorboards.

lines.speaker: THE HOUSE
lines.text: So she took the lantern. She followed the red thread down.

lines.speaker: THE HOUSE
lines.text: The cellar remembered hunger. The chapel remembered prayer. The water remembered a choir.

lines.speaker: THE HOUSE
lines.text: Keep the thread, little one. Something below is pulling back.

lines.speaker: THE CELLAR
lines.text: The first door was never locked. It was only swollen shut with damp, and something on the other side had been scratching at it for years.

lines.speaker: THE OSSUARY
lines.text: They stacked the bones with care. Each skull had a name sewn into the forehead. None of the names were finished.

lines.speaker: THE DROWNED GALLERY
lines.text: The water climbed the stairs to meet her. In the green light, painted saints turned their faces away.

lines.speaker: THE BONE ORCHARD
lines.text: The roots were not roots. The orchard had grown from everyone who ever said no to the house.

lines.speaker: THE HOLLOW
lines.text: There are no more stairs. Only a red room, warm as a mouth, and a heartbeat keeping time.

lines.speaker: THE GLUTTON
lines.text: It ate the last child whole. It kept the shoes.

lines.speaker: THE WEAVER
lines.text: She stitches the small ones back wrong, then calls them hers.

lines.speaker: THE DROWNED CHOIR
lines.text: Sing, little lamb. The water only wants a voice.

lines.speaker: THE ROOTBOUND MATRON
lines.text: Every branch was a name. Every name was a warning.

lines.speaker: THE HOLLOW HEART
lines.text: It has been waiting for a sibling.

lines.speaker: THE SEXTON
lines.text: He buried them all, and forgot to stop.

lines.speaker: THE CURATOR
lines.text: He keeps what the house cannot digest.

lines.speaker: THE BELL WIDOW
lines.text: Every bell has a name. She remembers all of them.

lines.speaker: THE TALLYMAN
lines.text: He counts what the house takes, and he is never wrong.

lines.speaker: THE GAUNT
lines.text: He has been hungry since before the stairs were built.

lines.speaker: THE CARVER
lines.text: She makes the small ones beautiful, then keeps the pieces.

lines.speaker: THE HOUSE
lines.text: The heart stops. The house is only a house. A child climbs toward the light, and the thread trails behind them.

lines.speaker: THE HOUSE
lines.text: The child cuts the thread. The house exhales. Below, something opens its eyes for the first time and calls them sibling.

lines.speaker: THE HOUSE
lines.text: The house has noticed you.

lines.speaker: THE THREAD
lines.text: Keep the thread, Wren. It is the only warm thing left.

lines.speaker: THE THREAD
lines.text: Breathe, Moth. The dust will hide you.

lines.speaker: THE THREAD
lines.text: Do not go out, Cinder. Not yet.

lines.speaker: THE THREAD
lines.text: Sing, Choir. Even here, something is listening.
